name: [🐈GUMBALL] Brainrot Battlegrounds
desc:
A funny silly battlegrounds game with little to no sweats. Just have fun in this unserious fighting game.

USE CODE "skibiwar" without quotation marks to redeem 12500 cash! (more codes available in the server)

NOTE: Servers automatically shut down after 5 hours of server time

NEXT CODE AT 2500 LIKES

Feeling Laggy? play in a private server for FREE!

💰Joining the group and liking the game will grant you doubled cash gain

Bosses spawn every hour in server time.

🖥️ Controls
G - Activate Ultimate 
F - Block
Q - Dash
Q (while ragdolled) - ragdoll cancel/evasive
Double Tap W - run
Left Click - Punch
1,2,3,4 - Character Abilities
R - Special Ability (some characters do not have an R and some abilities require ultimate meter)

📢LATEST UPDATE:
-SKIBI WAR EVENT

Best played on a Computer device
